attributes.title: Arctic TROPOMI CH4 Level 3, 2021
attributes.summary: Daily Level 3 composites of the column-averaged dry-air mole fraction of methane (XCH4) and its 1-sigma uncertainty from Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI over 50-90 N for 2021, on a 0.05 degree latitude-longitude grid of 800 x 7200 cells, one frame per UTC day (364 frames; days without a frame: 2021-08-04). The Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI) generated the composites from the ESA Level 2 methane product (S5P_RPRO_L2__CH4____, processor 02.04.00) with HARP spatial binning, keeping retrievals with a validity above 50. This store is HAMK's re-publication of FMI's Zarr store with CF and ACDD metadata, a CF time coordinate, 1-D coordinates, a grid mapping and the Zarr proj and spatial conventions; the data values are unchanged. Cells without valid retrievals, including the polar night, are NaN.
attributes.keywords: methane, CH4, XCH4, TROPOMI, Sentinel-5P, Copernicus, Level 3, Arctic
attributes.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Level 2 methane total column (S5P_RPRO_L2__CH4____, processor 02.04.00), gridded by FMI into daily Level 3 composites (https://arctic-tropomi-ch4-l3.lake.fmi.fi/arctic_tropomi_ch4_l3_2021.zarr)

attributes.history:
2023-11-12: FMI generated one daily composite per UTC day from all S5P_RPRO_L2__CH4____ orbit files (processor 02.04.00) whose sensing starts on that day, with HARP 1.18: harp.import_product('S5P_RPRO_L2__CH4____<YYYYMMDD>*.nc', operations='CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air_validity>50;keep(latitude_bounds,longitude_bounds,datetime_start,datetime_length,CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air,CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air_uncertainty);derive(CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air float [ppbv]);derive(CH4_column_volume_mixing_ratio_dry_air_uncertainty float [ppbv]);derive(datetime_stop {time} [days since 2000-01-01]);derive(datetime_start [days since 2000-01-01]);exclude(datetime_length);bin_spatial(3601, -90, 0.05, 7201, -180, 0.05);derive(latitude float {latitude});derive(longitude float {longitude})',reduce_operations='squash(time, (latitude, longitude, latitude_bounds, longitude_bounds));set("propagate_uncertainty", "correlated");bin()',post_operations='exclude(longitude_bounds, latitude_bounds)'). The 50-90 N rows of the composites were stored as float32 in FMI's Zarr store https://arctic-tropomi-ch4-l3.lake.fmi.fi/arctic_tropomi_ch4_l3_2021.zarr.
2026-10-14T10:44:03Z: HAMK copied every frame unchanged (verified by SHA-256 per frame), replaced the [year, month, day] date rows by a CF time coordinate with daily bounds, the 3-D float32 latitude/longitude meshes by exact 1-D float64 cell centres (the meshes were checked to match them within 2e-05 degrees), and added CF/ACDD attributes, a grid mapping, the Zarr proj and spatial conventions and consolidated metadata (hamk-uas/cards-zarr-optim arctic_tropomi_ch4_to_zarr.py git:dc8500edcb39 sha256:bc3a9fa59601).
attributes.comment: Each frame is labelled by the start of its UTC day and has nominal bounds of that day. It contains every Level 2 orbit file whose sensing starts on that day, so its last orbit ends about an hour after the following midnight (for example 2021-07-01T00:55:03Z to 2021-07-02T01:00:12Z).
